capabilities.basis: Exact SHA source: CPU/CUDA complex128; no Triton TaylorF2 entry point

workload.input_policy: Python host scalars/lists; conversion included in calls
workload.output_policy: device output retained; host copy excluded from timing

timing.synchronization: CUDA synchronize before/after each timed block
timing.cold_definition: first waveform call after imports, capability discovery and scheme entry

parity_method: Full complex hplus/hcross, exact zero support, frequency/epoch metadata. Scalar-vs-LAL relative L2 <1e-11 from test_taylorf2_public_torch_parity_and_dispatch; batch-vs-native-scalar pointwise rtol=2e-10, atol=0 from test_each_batch_row_matches_scalar_taylorf2. Direct batch-vs-LAL complex/amplitude/phase metrics are additionally reported without a new tolerance.
